v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.en: All ye nations * shout unto God with the voice of joy.

text.la: Inténde * voci oratiónis meæ, Rex meus et Deus meus.
text.en: Hearken to the voice * of my prayer, O my King and my God.

text.la: Deus maiestátis * intónuit: afférte glóriam nómini eius.
text.en: The God of majesty * hath thundered, ascribe to the Lord glory to his name.

text.la: Laudámus nomen tuum * ínclitum, Deus noster.
text.en: O God of majesty, * we praise thy glorious name.
O praise the Lord, * all ye nations. ‡

text.la: Nox præcéssit, dies autem appropinquávit. Abiciámus ergo ópera tenebrárum, et induámur arma lucis. Sicut in die honéste ambulémus.
text.en: The night is passed, and the day is at hand. Let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and put on the armour of light. Let us walk honestly, as in the day.

v.en: We are filled in the morning with thy mercy.

r.en: And we have rejoiced, and are delighted.

text.la: Benedíctus * Dóminus Deus Israël, quia visitávit et liberávit nos.
text.en: Blessed be the Lord * the God of Israel, because he has visited and redeemed his people.

text.la: Dírigat corda nostra, quǽsumus, Dómine, tuæ miseratiónis operátio: quia tibi sine te placére non póssumus.
text.en: Mercifully grant, O Lord, that thine effectual goodness may in all things direct our hearts, forasmuch as without thee we are not able to please thee.

text.la: Vestri capílli cápitis omnes numeráti sunt: nolíte timére: multis passéribus melióres estis vos.
text.en: Even the very hairs of your head are all numbered: fear not therefore; ye are of more value than many sparrows.

v.en: The saints shall rejoice in glory:

r.en: They shall be joyful in their beds.

text.la: Deus, qui nos concédis sanctórum Mártyrum tuórum Eustáchii et Sociórum eius natalítia cólere: da nobis in ætérna beatitúdine de eórum societáte gaudére.
text.en: O God, who dost permit us to keep the birthday of thy holy Martyrs Eustache and his companions, grant that we may enjoy their fellowship in everlasting happiness.
